# Cully v0.3.0

Cully brings a local advisor, shared agent tools, and durable personal context together in one open source project.

- Run the Docker self-hosted stack with `deploy/self-hosted/setup.sh`. It generates service credentials in `~/.cully/config.json` and starts PostgreSQL, Mem0, the data API and MCP from one Compose file. Optional Caddy and MCP Auth profiles provide OAuth; MCP defaults to no OAuth.
- Store authoritative source records in plain PostgreSQL. Mem0 handles semantic memory and recall with its own pgvector database and a local open source embedding model.
- Use MCP Auth's Go client SDK for MCP OAuth token validation. The private data API and Mem0 keep independent service credentials.
- Connect supported coding agents with `cully setup` and the combined Cully skill. Hosted agents can use the Cully MCP URL directly.
- Read the new hosted technical documentation and use the separate website and docs deployment flows.
- Use separate lint, unit, integration, end-to-end, Trivy, and CodeQL checks in CI.

This release starts a fresh Cully data store. See the [self-hosting guide](https://docs.cully.net/hosting) and [configuration reference](https://docs.cully.net/configuration) before deploying.
